en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-71 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ad ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Hamzih al-Ash’ari, on the authority of Yasir - the servant that he had heard Abal-Hassan al-Ridha (MGB) say,

“There are three days which are the most horrible for man: the day he is born, leaves his mother’s stomach and sees this world; the day that he dies and sees the Hereafter and its people; and the day he is resurrected and sees decrees which he has not seen in this world.

In these three instances, the Honorable the Exalted God sends peace on John (Yahya) and says, ‘So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!’

Jesus the son of Mary (MGB) has also sent peace on himself on these three instances and said, ‘So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)!’”
